opportunities.name: Tech lead research note (HN + GitHub -> note)
opportunities.description: For a tech project name, search Hacker News (Algolia) for the top story, look up the GitHub repo for stars and latest release, then save a 'Lead:' note with the combined facts.
steps: Search the project name on Hacker News/Algolia
Note top story title, points, age
Search the project name in GitHub search
Read star count and latest release date
Open the notes app, click New note
Type 'Lead: <project>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>' and press Enter
